PURPOSE: Canonical per-attempt execution-routing receipt for piging2 missions: ordered fallback attempt records (which execution target was tried, why abandoned, which served), per-target retry-budget arithmetic, guardrail verdict/deny receipts. Describes execution truth; does NOT select models/providers.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: FallbackAttemptRecord: ordered, evidence-bound record of one execution route {mission_id, route_path (deterministic strategy-tree position path), strategy, attempts[{started_at, ended_at, status, error_kind, retry_budget_used, verdicts[]}], outcome: SERVED|EXHAUSTED|GATEWAY_EXCEPTION|DENIED, served_by, evidence_digest}. Off-limits: model/provider selection (ConditionalRouter, weighted picking), the 100+ provider adapter catalog, caching, credentials/virtual keys, budgets - router stays frozen.
